commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
89' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) gets inside the box and tries to beat Rui Silva with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
88' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Betis.
88' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Betis win a corner.
87' Willian Jose (Betis) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Unai Simon and he's equal to it.
85' The substitution is prepared. Assane Diao (Betis) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nabil Fekir.
85' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
83' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
82' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) blows a clear opportunity! He needed only to tap the ball in, but narrowly misses the goal.
82' William Carvalho (Betis) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
81' Pablo Fornals (Betis) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
80' A lofted cross from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
79' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Unai Simon comes off his line to gather the ball.
72' Manuel Pellegrini is forced to make a change. Aitor Ruibal is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Hector Bellerin (Betis).
72' That's the end of the game for Aitor Paredes, who is replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
71' The injury to Aitor Ruibal (Betis) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
71' The attendance is 53537.
70' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
67' 3 - 1 Goal! Johnny (Betis) is teed up on the edge of the box by Nabil Fekir, and his howitzer of a shot into the top left corner gives the keeper no chance. 3:1.

64' William Carvalho (Betis) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Unai Simon has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
60' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) replacing Benat Prados Diaz.
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) is replacing Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
60' German Pezzella (Betis) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

60' German Pezzella (Betis) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top of the net, but Unai Simon keeps the ball out.
59' Imanol Garcia de Albeniz (Ath Bilbao) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
59' Imanol Garcia de Albeniz (Ath Bilbao) brings an opponent down and Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game. Betis win a free kick.
57' Pablo Fornals (Betis) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul.
57' The linesman raises his flag. Rodri (Betis) is adjudged offside.
55' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
53' Nabil Fekir (Betis) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
52' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Betis force a corner. They send men into the box.
51' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Rodri (Betis) replaces Chimy Avila.
47' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
47' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) makes a strong challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul.
46' The game is over for Oihan Sancet. Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Sergi Altimira is replaced by William Carvalho (Betis).
46' The whistle blows and Guillermo Cuadra starts the second half.
45+8' The end of the first half.
45+7' 2 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight under the crossbar. He makes it 2:1.
45+7' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) will take a corner kick.
45+6' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Unai Simon, who smothers the ball.
45+4' Yuri Berchiche is being substituted because of an injury. Ernesto Valverde Tejedor sends Imanol Garcia de Albeniz (Ath Bilbao) on the pitch.
45+3' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' Pablo Fornals (Betis) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
45' Pablo Fornals (Betis) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
41' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!

40' Yet another yellow card and Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is sent off for talking out of turn to the referee. Definitely a harebrained moment from the player. Guillermo Cuadra doesn't allow any discussions.
40' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
40' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Betis.
40' Now Betis have a corner. Willian Jose (Betis) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
38' 2 - 0 Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) scores an unlucky own goal! He deflects a shot into his own net.
37' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao).
34' Chimy Avila (Betis) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
32' Yellow card. Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
32' Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul after Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
32' Nabil Fekir (Betis) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
31' Nabil Fekir (Betis) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
31' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
30' What was Chimy Avila (Betis) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
30' The referee blows his whistle as Chimy Avila (Betis) was too aggressive in his challenge.
29' Guillermo Cuadra couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) and blew his whistle. Betis have a free kick.
26' Pablo Fornals (Betis) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick to Ath Bilbao.

24' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Chimy Avila (Betis) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
23' Guillermo Cuadra blows the whistle, Nabil Fekir (Betis) is penalised for a foul.
22' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. Betis have a free kick.
21' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
19' Nabil Fekir (Betis) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
19' A cross into the box from Chimy Avila (Betis) is cleared. Betis will take a corner kick.

13' 1 - 0 Goal! A terrific long pass from Willian Jose picks out an unmarked Chimy Avila (Betis) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
12' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

10' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Ath Bilbao can continue in their attacking effort.

8' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. It's a free kick to Ath Bilbao, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

7' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Betis, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
5' Nabil Fekir (Betis) attempts to send in a cross from the free kick, but it lacks accuracy and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
4' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. A free kick has been awarded to Betis.
